Package com.csse3200.game.win

Class WinEvaluator

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.win.WinEvaluator
public final class WinEvaluator extends Object
The win class. It decides the SCALE of a win: given what has happened in the game, it says which of the three WinTiers the player has earned, or that they have not won.

The rules, in order (each one is tested):

  1. If the final boss has not been defeated, the tier is WinTier.NONE. Nothing else can win the game: killing every mini boss does not end it. The counts are still worked out, so a screen could show progress.
  2. Otherwise the tier is at least WinTier.VICTORY.
  3. If every required mini boss in BossRoster appears among the killed enemy ids, the tier is at least WinTier.GLORY.
  4. If the tier is Glory AND at least QUESTS_REQUIRED_FOR_LEGEND quests have been completed, the tier is WinTier.LEGEND. Quests alone never lift a Victory: Legend needs Glory first.

Why Zeus must die, and the mini bosses only scale the win. Making the mini bosses an alternative way to win would let a player skip the final fight and would make the side rooms mandatory, which the doors do not enforce. As a scale they are optional, they pay off, and the game still has one clear ending.

Pure logic. evaluate(boolean, java.util.Collection<java.lang.String>, int) takes everything as arguments and touches no static state, no UI and no physics, so it is tested without a game. evaluateNow(boolean) is the thin wrapper that reads the live registries.

Why the final boss arrives as a boolean. A kill is saved when the enemy entity is disposed, which happens just after it dies. Zeus's own id may therefore not be in the registry yet at the instant the win is checked, so the caller says whether he has fallen.

Limitations: it does not look at deaths, time or difficulty; it does not know which quests exist, only how many were completed; extra ids in the killed set (any enemy in the game) are ignored.

      public static final int QUESTS_REQUIRED_FOR_LEGEND
      Quests that must be completed for WinTier.LEGEND. Set to 0 to make Legend depend only on the mini bosses, for example while no NPC gives quests yet.

    • evaluate

      public static WinResult evaluate(boolean finalBossDefeated, Collection<String> killedEnemyIds, int questsCompleted)
      Works out the tier from explicit inputs.
      Parameters:
      finalBossDefeated - whether Zeus in Level 3 has been defeated
      killedEnemyIds - every enemy id killed so far, in the <map name>:<x>,<y> form; null is treated as empty; duplicates and unknown ids are ignored
      questsCompleted - how many quests have been completed; not negative
      Returns:
      the result, never null
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if questsCompleted is negative
